name: Rosé Lace Balconette Bra
description: Fully lined floral lace over underwired, lightly padded cups that push you up and put you on display — finished with satin bows and adjustable satin straps, made to be slid off your shoulders. Hand wash cold, after.
fitNote: Underwired cups that lift and frame — take your usual size; the straps do the rest.

name: Rosé Lace High-Waist Brief
description: High-waisted, full coverage and still pure temptation: soft floral lace with a scalloped edge that hugs every curve and a cotton gusset where it counts. Wear it with the Rosé balconette, and let them unwrap the set. Hand wash cold.
fitNote: Sits high on the waist and hugs without digging in. True to size.

name: Camille Satin Bow Bralette
description: Silky stretch satin, wire-free with removable pads, and one hand-tied bow at the centre — the only thing keeping it on. Pull the ribbon and the rest is up to you. Machine wash delicate.
fitNote: Soft and wire-free with a little give — between sizes, size down.

name: Juliette Lace Bodysuit
description: Fully lined lace that clings from a plunging sweetheart neckline all the way down, with a hook-and-eye gusset for when the moment can’t wait. Sculpted, sheer and sinful. Hand wash cold.
fitNote: Fitted close through the body — if you're long in the torso, go one size up.

name: Margot Silk Slip
description: Pure mulberry silk, bias cut to slide over every curve, with a lace-trimmed neckline that slips just low enough. Wear nothing underneath — it’s that kind of slip. Dry clean recommended.
fitNote: Bias-cut silk that skims rather than clings. Your usual size.

name: Amélie Garter Belt
description: A stretch lace waistband with four adjustable straps and gold-tone metal clasps, made to hold up your stockings and hold their attention. The finishing touch they’ll take their time taking off. Hand wash cold.
fitNote: Stretch lace waist with four adjustable straps — true to size.

name: Pearl Seduction Bikini
description: Fully lined ivory satin triangles held up by nothing but strands of pearls — a pearl halter, pearl sides, a barely-there cut and a cheeky back made to be stared at. Hand wash cold, and keep your pearls out of the chlorine, darling.
details: Hand wash cold; keep the pearls out of chlorine
fitNote: Fully adjustable pearl halter and sides — take your usual size.
blurb: Ivory satin held on by strands of pearls.

name: Scarlet Sin Bikini
description: Fully lined crimson, tied with nothing but intent: an adjustable halter, back ties begging to be pulled and a tie-side Brazilian bottom that shows off everything behind you. Quick-dry and chlorine resistant — you’ll be wet a lot.
fitNote: Tie-side bottom and an adjustable halter — your usual size, tied as tight as you dare.
blurb: Crimson triangles, tied with nothing but intent.

name: Noir Temptress Bikini
description: Fully lined matte black with gold-tone adjustable buckles, a double-strap thong bottom and a criss-cross strappy back — dangerously minimal, buckled on and begging to be undone.
fitNote: The buckled straps sit snug — between sizes, go up one.
blurb: Black straps, gold buckles and a daring thong back.

name: Golden Goddess Bikini
description: Liquid-gold metallic foil, fully lined, that catches the sun and every stare: a halter and back ties up top, a high tie-side bottom and a cheeky back that leaves little to the imagination. Rinse in cool water after — you’ll be too hot to handle.
details: Rinse in cool water after wear
fitNote: Ties at the neck, back and hips, so it fits exactly how you tie it. True to size.
blurb: Liquid gold that catches every eye.

name: Vesper Strap Cage Set
description: Fully lined micro triangle cups, an elastic strap cage with gold O-rings around every curve and a triple-strap micro G-string — more skin than lingerie, and that’s the point. Hand wash cold.
details: Elastic strap cage with gold O-rings
fitNote: A snug strap cage — size up if you're between sizes.

name: Élodie Split Babydoll
description: Lined lace balconette cups and a split-front chiffon skirt that falls open the moment you move, with a micro lace G-string underneath — made to be untied. Hand wash cold.
fitNote: Floats from the bust and parts at the front — size down for a closer fit.

name: Noémie Plunge Teddy
description: Fluid satin with fully lined cups, plunging all the way to the navel, with side cut-outs and a thong back — one thin strap away from nothing at all. Hand wash cold.
fitNote: Fluid satin with stretch through the sides. True to size.

name: Sabine Crystal Set
description: Lined mocha satin micro triangles edged in crystal chain, a body chain that drips down your stomach and a crystal-strap G-string — it sparkles in the dark and covers almost nothing. Hand wash and lay flat.
details: Crystal chain edging and body chain
fitNote: Adjustable chains and straps — your usual size.

name: Sakura Silk Kimono Set
description: A short wine satin kimono that slides off your shoulders and falls open over a lined lace plunge bra and a matching lace thong — tied at the waist with a sash made for one slow pull. Hand wash cold.
fitNote: The kimono is loose and wraps to fit; the bra and thong are true to size.

name: Delilah Backless String Dress
description: A black satin slip mini with nothing behind it but strings — the back bared from the shoulders to the base of your spine and laced shut with thin criss-cross ties you'll want undone. Hand wash cold.
fitNote: The ties lace it as close as you like — your usual size.

name: Rouge Eyelash Lace Bodysuit
description: Red eyelash lace with lined cups, plunging all the way to your navel, cut extreme high on the hip and finished in a thong back with a strappy open back — the bodysuit that does all the talking. Hand wash cold.
fitNote: Cut close and high — long in the torso? Go one size up.

name: Ibiza Plunge Swimsuit
description: Wine red, plunging all the way down and cut so high on the leg it barely counts as a swimsuit — a halter neck, a back bared right down to a tiny thong, and nothing left to the imagination. Chlorine resistant, so you can stay in as long as they keep staring.
fitNote: Two bands, one halter — if you're tall, take a size up.

name: Mykonos Chain Bikini
description: Fully lined micro triangles hanging from a gold-tone chain halter, back and sides, with a micro thong bottom — dripping in metal, barely in fabric. Rinse after wear.
details: Gold-tone chain halter, back and sides
fitNote: Gold-tone chains adjust at the neck and back. True to size.

name: Tulum Crochet Bikini
description: Hand-crochet with lined cups, shell-bead tassel ties and a crochet micro G-string — an open-weave bohemian bikini that hides very little and teases the rest. Hand wash cold.
fitNote: Hand-crochet with a soft stretch — size down for a closer fit.

name: Saint-Tropez Cut-out Monokini
description: More cut-out than swimsuit: one lined front panel plunging to the navel, dramatic side cut-outs baring your waist and a thong back. Technically one piece, practically nothing.
fitNote: Sculpted and close-fitting — between sizes, go up one.

name: Capri Bandeau Bikini
description: A strapless black micro bandeau that only just stays up and a high-cut thong that does even less — sleek, minimal and made to be slowly untied by the pool. Rinse after wear.
fitNote: Strapless and snug, with no give — size up if unsure.

name: Maldives O-Ring Bikini
description: Glossy and fully lined, linked with gold-tone O-rings, with a micro tanga on high side straps that bare your hips — sun-kissed and sinful. Quick-dry, so you never have to cover up.
fitNote: High side straps adjust at the hips. True to size.

name: Bora Scrunch Bikini
description: A ruched, lined triangle top that lifts, a scrunch-back micro bottom that sculpts your behind and an extreme high leg that makes your legs go on forever. Quick-dry, slow burn.
fitNote: Ruched to lift and sculpt — your usual size.

name: Vixen Cut-out Bandage Mini
description: Sculpting black bandage knit that holds you in where it covers you, with sweeping cut-outs that bare your waist and ribs, a low scoop and a strappy open back, finished with a micro hem. The dress you wear when you're not going home alone.
fitNote: Sculpting bandage knit that holds you in — size up if between sizes.

name: Siren Chainmail Mini
description: Liquid metal chainmail mesh with a lined front, a cowl plunge on a halter neck, a fully open back down to the base of your spine and a high side split. It pours over your body and moves like sin.
fitNote: Halter-tied with a fluid drape. True to size.

name: Muse Double-Slit Gown
description: Heavy satin with a lined bodice — floor-length, but don’t be fooled: a navel-deep plunge, double slits to the hip on both sides and an open back. Every step is a reveal.
fitNote: Heavy satin with a fitted bodice. Your usual size.

name: Desire Latex Micro Dress
description: Glossy lined latex with corset boning and lace-up sides, cut to a micro hem — a second skin with nowhere to hide, and nothing you’d want to.
fitNote: Latex with corset boning and zero stretch — go up one size.

name: Lola Fringe Micro Dress
description: Hand-beaded fringe that swings with every move, a plunging halter, open sides and a micro length — the beads part to show everything in between.
fitNote: Fringe that moves with you and a forgiving cut — size down if between.

name: Nightshade Plunge Mini
description: Blush satin that plunges to a deep V between lined cups, skims every curve and stops high on the thigh — with an open back that drops away to the waist and thin straps crossing your bare skin. Barely held in.
details: Open back with thin cross straps
fitNote: Adjustable straps with a side zip. True to size.

name: Bijou Crystal Two-Piece
description: A lined, crystal-embellished bralette and a micro skirt with a high slit, dripping in crystal fringe — the whole midriff on show, catching every light and every eye in the room. Specialist clean only.
fitNote: Adjustable bralette and a fitted micro skirt — your usual size.

name: Fleur Embroidered Satin Slip
description: Innocent from one side, wicked from the other: ivory satin down one half, sheer tulle sewn with pastel blossoms down the other, so one hip is always on show. Embroidered cups edged in tiny flowers, a satin bow under the bust, a scalloped lace hem split at the front, and a back scooped open almost to the waist — nothing underneath required. Hand wash cold.
details: Satin with a sheer embroidered tulle side panel
Lined embroidered cups with a flower trim
Open scooped back with a hook band
fitNote: Skims the body with adjustable straps. Your usual size.

name: Lotus Satin Cheongsam
description: Buttoned up to the throat and open everywhere else. Ivory satin jacquard woven with blossoms and edged in black piping, a mandarin collar fastened with a black frog button, a keyhole cut out right where you'll want to be looked at, and a single front panel buttoned at the corners. The sides are slit from the hem all the way up to your arms, and the back is bare to the waist above a short gathered skirt. Hand wash cold.
details: Mandarin halter collar with frog button
Open sides, slit hem to underarm
fitNote: Halter neck and open sides — fits most busts; your usual size.

name: Scarlet Butterfly Teddy
description: A scarlet butterfly landed on your chest and decided to stay. Lined satin cups shaped as wings, every vein embroidered in raised red thread, scalloped edges and long tails trailing down your waist. A satin choker holds it at the throat, one thin strap runs down your stomach to a tiny G-string finished with two satin rosettes, and the back is nothing but straps. Hand wash cold.
details: Lined satin butterfly cups with vein embroidery
Centre strap to a rosette G-string
Strappy open back with hook band
fitNote: Adjustable straps and choker. Your usual size.
moments: making him forget his own name

name: Bloom Lace-Up Ruffle Mini
description: Sweet print, wicked intentions. Watercolour blossoms on fine stretch mesh, lined cups laced together down the middle with criss-cross ties over your bare cleavage, and soft ruffles cascading all the way down to the opposite hip. One side gathers into a ruched drawstring you can pull as high as you dare, finished with a flirty ruffle hem. Hand wash cold.
details: Lined cups with a lace-up centre
fitNote: Stretchy and bodycon, with an adjustable side drawstring. Your usual size.
moments: a long brunch that turns into dinner

name: Jade Dragon Cheongsam
description: Buttoned to the throat, bare where it counts. Black stretch satin crawling with pink and champagne dragons, every edge bound in bright gold piping, a mandarin collar fastened with a gold frog button and an open bust that comes with a pair of black heart pasties. The back opens into a keyhole down to your shoulder blades and the skirt is slit high on both sides. Hand wash cold.
details: Printed stretch satin with gold piping
Mandarin halter collar with frog button
High side slits with frog buttons
fitNote: Stretch satin with a halter collar. Your usual size.

name: Wisteria Embroidered Bustier Set
description: A garden in bloom, laced tight around your waist. Underwired embroidered balconette cups lift you up, a sheer mesh midriff blossoms with flowers, and satin ribbons criss-cross up both sides and tie in bows you'll want undone. With a matching embroidered thong on double strings. Hand wash cold.
details: Embroidered tulle with lined balconette cups
Satin ribbon lacing at both sides
fitNote: Underwired with adjustable straps and side lacing. Your usual size.
moments: being untied one bow at a time
